lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines visible. Spacing is relatively uniform across the anterior torso but increases in the mid-torso section before tightening again at the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th line from the anterior, where the line splits toward the dorsal boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments and early terminations are visible on the 4th, 6th, and 11th lines, which fail to reach the ventral midline of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, showing higher density near the posterior-most vertical line.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-connected horizontal geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct white patch on the lower neck/throat area; single white circular spot located on the sub-ocular cheek; white transverse bands located on the mid-sections of the fore and hind limbs.
